name: 📞 Gameplan Call Unlocked
instructions:
You've earned it.

Reaching Sage means you've done real work. Not watching. Not thinking about it. Doing it.

That work earned you an invitation.

The Gameplan Call is 60 minutes with me, one-on-one. We map your next 12 months together. What to build. What to cut. What to prioritize.

You get a week inside Academy to experience the work firsthand. Your investment is $100. That's not the Academy price. That's the seat at the table.

Book when you're ready:
[BOOKING LINK]

No pressure. No pitch. Just the gameplan.

name: Trial 3 — Build Your Framework
instructions:
Clients want to see the path before they walk it. If your process is a black box, they stay out.

A framework is 3 to 5 steps that walk your client from where they are to where they want to be. Not 17 steps. Not vague phases. Clear moves.

To complete this trial:

1. Watch the Offer Kickstarter lesson on the Framework.

2. Map your own framework. 3 to 5 steps. Use simple words. Name each step like a promise, not a chore.

3. Post your framework in the group with #trial3framework. A list, a sketch, a diagram — whatever shows the shape.

4. Read 3 other members' frameworks. Ask one real question on each. Not compliments. Questions that test if the step actually works.

Earn your way. Do all three parts.

name: Trial 5 — Crush Your Top Objection
instructions:
Every sale has a moment where the prospect hesitates. "Is this worth it?" "Can I afford it?" "What if it doesn't work?"

Objections aren't walls. They're doors. The confident answer builds trust. The fumbled answer kills the sale.

To complete this trial:

1. Watch the Offer Kickstarter lesson on Objection Crusher.

2. Write the answer to this exact question: "Why should I buy this from you, right now?" Be human. Be specific. No scripts. No pressure tactics.

3. Post your answer in the group with #trial5objection.

4. Read 3 other members' answers. Tell them where it sounds real and where it sounds rehearsed. That's the gift.

Earn your way. Do all three parts. Finish the trial. Earn the path.

name: 🔟 10 Leads Captured
instructions:
10 leads. That's not a fluke. That's a system working.

You've proven the chatbot isn't just a tool — it's a funnel. People are entering. Conversations are happening. You're in business.

This milestone fires automatically when your 10th lead lands.

Share the win with the group. Your momentum helps others see what's possible.

name: 🤖 Activate Your Chatbot Trial
instructions:
Talk is talk. Action is different.

Activating your chatbot trial means you're done learning about it — you're using it. Full access, 30 days, real leads possible.

To complete this milestone:

1. Open the Chatbot Kickstarter course in the community.
2. Follow the setup steps to activate your 30-day trial.
3. Send one test message through the bot to confirm it's live.
4. Post a screenshot of your live chatbot in the group.

Your clock starts now. 30 days to get your first lead.

name: 🏟️ 50 Leads Captured
instructions:
50 leads. You're running a real lead generation engine.

This is the territory where members ask themselves: "What else could this system do if I had full support?" That question isn't an accident. It's the math.

50 leads in a free trial proves you can execute. You've earned more than points — you've earned a seat at the next table.

When this fires, expect a personal note from me.

name: Daily Hashtag Post
instructions:
Each weekday (Mon–Fri), Danno announces the hashtag of the day in the free Facebook group.

To complete this quest:
1. Find today's hashtag in the pinned morning post.
2. Create a post in the free group using that hashtag.
3. Message the chatbot with "DONE" and the link to your post.

That's it. Chatbot verifies the post exists and awards your points.

Build a streak. 10 pts day 1. 20 day 2. 40 day 3. 80 day 4. 160 day 5. Miss a day and you reset to 10.

name: 🎣 Chatbot Lead Captured
instructions:
Every lead your chatbot captures earns you 25 points. No quest to complete. No submission to make. The tool works, you earn.

This is the difference between theory and results. You used the system, and it worked. Here's your proof.

Check your leaderboard position — every lead moves you up.

name: 🎯 First Lead Captured
instructions:
Your first real lead. Someone who hit your chatbot, followed the flow, and gave you their email or phone number.

That's not a theory. That's a stranger who wants what you offer.

This milestone fires automatically when your chatbot captures your first lead.

When it does — post it in the group with #firstlead. Celebrate. Tag someone whose work helped you get there. Pay it forward.

name: 🏛️ Inner Circle Workshop Invitation
instructions:
Sentinel.

You stood guard over your own progress. Month after month. You did the work when nobody was watching.

That earned you an invitation most members will never see.

The Inner Circle Workshop is in person. At my office. One day. Intimate. You sit with me and my Academy clients — the same ones paying $10,000 to be there.

Next workshop:
[DATE + DETAILS]

If this is your moment, reply and I'll send the details. Spots are limited by design.

name: Trial 2 — Write Your Big Promise
instructions:
Clients don't buy your product. They buy the transformation.

Your Big Promise is one sentence. It says who you help, what shift they get, and what they leave behind. If you can't say it in one sentence, they won't buy.

To complete this trial:

1. Watch the Offer Kickstarter lesson on the Big Promise.

2. Write your Big Promise using the template: "I help [who] go from [pain] to [outcome] in [time] without [thing they hate]." Refine it until it hurts a little. Vague = no sale.

3. Post it in the group with #trial2promise. Ask for honest feedback.

4. Read 3 other members' promises and leave real feedback. Point out what's muddy. Point out what landed. That's how they sharpen, and how you sharpen yours.

Earn your way. Do all three parts.

name: Trial 1 — Define Your Ideal Avatar
instructions:
Your ideal client isn't "anyone with money." That's why your marketing feels like shouting into the void.

To complete this trial:

1. Watch the Offer Kickstarter lesson on Ideal Avatar.

2. Write out your avatar in detail. Not age and income. Their real pains. What they fear. What they secretly want. Where they hang out. What language they actually use.

3. Post it in the group with #trial1avatar. Share the real work, not the polished version.

4. Read 3 other members' avatars and leave a real comment on each one. Not "great job." Something that sharpens their work.

Earn your way. Do all three parts.

name: 🎓 Complete Chatbot Kickstarter Course
instructions:
A chatbot without a plan is just noise on your site.

The Chatbot Kickstarter course walks you through the full setup — flows, triggers, automations, lead capture. Finish it, and you know how the machine works.

To complete this milestone:

1. Work through every lesson in the Chatbot Kickstarter course.
2. Build the starter flow inside your chatbot tool.
3. Test it. Break it. Fix it.
4. Post in the group: one thing you built, one thing that surprised you, one thing you're still figuring out.

That's how you learn the tool. And that's how the community helps you level up.

name: Trial 4 — Choose Your Offer Container
instructions:
The format you deliver in matters. 1:1 is not group. Group is not course. The container shapes the experience and your income.

To complete this trial:

1. Watch the Offer Kickstarter lesson on the Offer Container.

2. Choose your format. 1:1 coaching, group program, course, workshop, membership, done-for-you — pick what fits your energy, your offer, and your life. Set the price. Set the length. Set what's included.

3. Post your container in the group with #trial4container. Format, price, length, what's included, what's not.

4. Read 3 other members' containers. Tell them one thing that will help them sell it. One real thing.

Earn your way. Do all three parts.
